reason: B is the stronger proposal because W–P interactions and W’s diffusion-slowing refractory character provide a physically plausible mechanism directly supported by prior Fe–P glass data showing increased crystallization-onset temperatures, while extending that result into the unexplored high-entropy composition. It also specifies a dopant level, cooling and reheating conditions, quantitative thermal outcomes, and a comparative falsification test more clearly than A, whose B-substitution mechanism is supported mainly by generic size-mismatch arguments.
